Settings

Advisory only. Colours use ceiling, visibility and tailwind only. RVR reports, METAR trends, thunderstorms, icing and shear are not modelled. In VFR the colours use visibility and ceiling only; wind, approach minima, RVR and alternates are not considered. Always verify against the official forecast, AIP and OM.
Max tailwind (kt)
Closest range (nm)Aerodromes within this range of your position, 50 to 200. At most 8, ILS aerodromes first.
Alternate radius (nm)Route alternates within this radius of the destination, 20 to 200.
Green defaults
Green ceiling (ft)Used only for aerodromes without a listed MSA. With an MSA the ceiling is MSA minus elevation.
Green visibility (m)Used at every aerodrome. The MSA says nothing about visibility.
Rules
Data and legend
Top strip: the forecast at that time. Wide bar: the result if your ETA is then. Solid bracket: ETA ±1 h. Dashed bracket: ETA ±2 h for +75kg fuel, starting at departure if that is later.
